question: What is the air quality in Central Singapore right now?
name: ChatGPT
answer:
As of **1:00 a.m. Singapore time on October 16**, Central Singapore’s **24-hour PSI was 206 — Very Unhealthy**. The **1-hour PM2.5 reading was 170 µg/m³ — High**. ([checkpointsg.com](https://www.checkpointsg.com/haze?utm_source=openai))

NEA’s reported guidance is to avoid strenuous outdoor activity; older adults, children, pregnant people, and those with heart or lung conditions should avoid outdoor activity. The readings can change hourly. ([checkpointsg.com](https://www.checkpointsg.com/haze?utm_source=openai))
